runs.text: This program computes how many 40-seat buses are needed. With 95 pupils it says 3, which is right. Find a number of pupils for which it gets it wrong.

hints.text: Do worked examples with several numbers. When do you need exactly a whole number of buses?
Think about the edge cases: what happens right when the pupils fill the buses with nobody left over?
With 80 pupils the program says 3 and 2 are needed. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Find another number that breaks it, and a third one greater than 100. (Any multiple of 40: 40, 120, 160.)
Any multiple of 40 breaks the program. Before typing the input, try to explain why.
